claims.text: Trajectory matters more than single lab values.
claims.poster_quote: Trajectory matters more than single lab values.
claims.label: supported
claims.paper_evidence: The central insight motivating this work is that the trajectory of a biomarker may carry more predictive information than any single value.

claims.text: We use 12 routine biomarkers to predict decline pre-clinically via EHRs.
claims.poster_quote: We use 12 routine biomarkers to predict decline pre-clinically via EHRs.

claims.paper_evidence: Using the All of Us Research Program (N = 297,861; 11.1% cases), we derived trajectory features (slope, variability, delta, mean) for twelve biomarkers over a three-year pre-index window.
claims.reason: The abstract confirms the use of 12 routine biomarkers to predict functional decline pre-clinically via EHRs.
